The '''Great Hall''' of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was an annex of the [[City/Legends|city's]] main [[Theed Hangar/Legends|hangar complex]].

==History==
During the reign of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]], the Naboo were approached by [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], an entity within the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], with an offer of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and exporting the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] that was found in abundance in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] core. Despite trepidation at the idea of using primarily offworld businesses to jump-start the plasma industry, Tapalo agreed to the terms of [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] as the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] was planning to back the king's bid for reelection.<ref name="SWDP" />

When construction commenced existing parklands just east of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] were removed and the and adjacent the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] was rerouted to make room for the triple-domes of the new [[Plasma Refinery Complex]] and the hangar facility. Constructed by [[Outer Rim Construction and Assembly/Legends|Outer Rim Construction and Assembly]],<ref name="SWDP" /> the Great Hall served as a location for formal events at the hangar. The high ceiling and tall windows made for an ideal point from which the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|sitting monarch]] could watch ceremonial parades.<ref name="SWCL" />

When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the planet, [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered for an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] to be stationed outside the Great Hall and the hangar, where it fired upon [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] leaving the hangar during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|space battle]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> Over a decade later, after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose from the ashes of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Great Hall was destroyed during a [[Uprising in Theed|plot]] by anti-Imperial agents [[Roan Lands]] and [[Ferus Olin]]. Taking advantage of the munitions stored in the hangar by the Empire, Olin and Lands detonated the explosives which took with them half the hangar and the Great Hall.<ref name="DON" />
